milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the red stained glass corner pillars and face them to demonstrate they've 'found' the landmark. Target is the nearest red stained glass pillar at spawn-relative (6, 1, 6). max_distance=10 requires some movement toward the structure (pillar is ~8.5 blocks from spawn, so player must walk a few steps and face it). facing_tolerance=60 ensures intentional observation.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind='block') because purple stained glass panes drop NOTHING when broken without Silk Touch — inventory_has would never trigger. Instead, we verify at least 1 of the 9 panes has been removed from its original position. The 9 panes are at spawn-relative x=[8,9,10], y=[0,1,2], z=12. Box (5,-1,9) to (13,5,15) generously encloses all positions with ±3 margin. max_count=8 means at least 1 pane must be broken.
